title: Can I SURVIVE Chaturaji Chess?
summary: Chess.com 4-player Chaturaji: four small armies (red, blue, yellow, green) in the corners of an 8x8 board; players capture pieces and checkmate for points. Boats move like rooks. Tony (lowest rated, vs ~1900-2300 humans and later viewers) finishes second three times in a row and never wins (ends ~22:13 asking if second counts as surviving).
rules: 4 players on an 8x8 board, turn order red, blue, yellow, green (Tony as yellow moved third in game 1).
Each army (corner): king, knight, bishop, boat + 4 pawns (chess.com Chaturaji setup, frame).
Boat moves like a rook; other pieces like chess (bishop, knight, king, pawns forward in their own direction).

Points for captures and for checkmating/eliminating players; eliminated players' pieces go out of play (greyed, can't move or be captured for points? — 'put all of the rest of their pieces out of play').
Pawns promote (Tony promoted to a boat).
No stalemate: a stalemated player's material/points can go to another player (red 'gives it to yellow').
A player far enough ahead in points can 'claim the win'.
win_condition: Finish first on points (claim the win); goal: win one game (not achieved; placed 2nd three times).

opponent.name: Three online humans per game (e.g. ~1900, 2000, 2300; viewers JMeister, Anon ~1500)
